svg.title: On cash-and-carry, SAC's edge over its funding rule is small but positive

svg.text: On cash-and-carry, SAC's edge over its funding rule is small but positive
Growth of $1, out of sample, 2023 to 2026, daily, after modelled costs.
Exchange, counterparty and intrabar liquidation risk are not modelled. Compare lines, not levels.
